# spaceman identity

Your linked sign-in identities: list and unlink (a user's: `spaceman user identity`).

Aliases: `identities`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman identity list`](#spaceman-identity-list) | Your linked sign-in identities |
| [`spaceman identity unlink`](#spaceman-identity-unlink) | Unlink one of your identities (ends every session of yours) |

## spaceman identity list

Your linked sign-in identities.

```sh
spaceman identity list [flags]
```

Aliases: `ls`.

API: `list-my-identities` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman identity unlink

Unlink one of your identities (ends every session of yours).

```sh
spaceman identity unlink [flags]
```

API: `unlink-my-identity` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--issuer` | string |  | issuer of the identity (required) |
| `--subject` | string |  | subject of the identity (required) |
| `--yes` | bool |  | confirm: unlink the identity and end every session of yours |
